name: wolf-rain-shake
comment: WP-2.3 task 1. A wolf (id 0) alone in the fenced stone pen of entity/sheep-shear, no player. t=0 set_weather raining (rain_time 100000): the rain strength passes 0.2 at t = 20 and the wolf is wet until t = 100 (Entity.isWet: canBlockBeRainedOn); EntityWolf.onUpdate (EntityWolf.java:152-196) sets isWolfShaking and holds the animation off. t=60 the rain stops; once the strength is below 0.2 an onLivingUpdate on the ground with no path starts the shake (t = 102; field_25052_g, :143-148; setEntityState(8) is empty in World): it holds the wolf still (isMovementCeased, so EntityCreature wanders no more), plays mob.wolf.shake (two rand draws), runs 40 ticks at +0.05 and from 0.4 spawns up to 7 splash particles a tick (two rand draws each). rng_state, entity_state and weather every tick.
